annotations.title: Gold Hub: live gold, its market value and where the money goes when gold is sold

description: The OwlChart Gold Hub in one tool (v5.890): what=market (gold futures GC=F and spot XAU/USD, change against yesterday's close, day high and low, the highest trade and its date, 7 day, 30 day, 1 year and year to date moves, gold/silver, market open or closed, the gold miners and the PAXG and XAUT premium), brief (the facts, the strings the page prints, a plain read, the headline), rotation (days=90 or 30: for the dollar, yields, T-bills, bonds, metals, oil, stocks, crypto and the VIX, today's move, the average move and the share of days it rose on the days gold fell hard, a plain label RECEIVING, SOLD WITH GOLD or NEUTRAL, the 30 and 90 day correlation word, today's ranked receivers and the markets sold together with gold), flows (tokenised gold PAXG and XAUT supply and the day's mint or burn read from the Ethereum contracts, CFTC managed money net long in COMEX gold, spot Bitcoin fund flows, stablecoins issued or redeemed, the central bank figure when entered), ratios (gold/silver, ounces of gold per Bitcoin, gold/S&P 500, gold/oil, gold/copper, each with its five year range), value (all the gold above ground in dollars, the change today, from the 90 day high, this year and from the highest trade, against Bitcoin, all crypto and US M2), rates (US 10 year yield, the 10 year real yield from treasury.gov, the dollar index, the next Fed meeting and odds) news (gold, Fed, dollar and central bank headlines), crypto (v5.892, is gold money reaching crypto: the verdict NOT RECEIVING, STARTING or RECEIVING with a 0 to 100 gauge and its seven signs as ticks, gold fund flows against Bitcoin fund flows in dollars from the files of the issuers, the Gold to Bitcoin days in 30 and 90 days, stablecoins, the Coinbase and Upbit premiums, spot taker netflow, T-bill fund flows, today hour by hour in one sentence, the size of the prize and what Bitcoin did after each past RECEIVING day), bitcoin (v5.894, gold against Bitcoin over one year: both prices with the move today, over 30 days and 1 year, ounces of gold for one Bitcoin and its change, the 30 and 90 day correlation, what Bitcoin did on the days gold fell hard), investor (v5.893, the whole long-term picture in one call: price, market value, valuation percentiles, fund holdings and flows, futures positioning, central banks, the crypto verdict, correlations and the ways to own gold), valuation (gold in today's dollars after US inflation, the percentile of the price, the real price and gold/S&P 500 against their own history, returns, deepest fall and yearly swing over 1, 5, 10 and 20 years; a percentile, never a view on cheap or expensive), cot (CFTC gold futures: managed money, swap dealers and producers, net in contracts and tonnes, open interest, the 5 year percentile of the fund position), etf (GLD, GLDM and IAU: tonnes, assets, money in or out over the day, 5 and 21 days, from the issuers), own (five ways to own gold side by side and the prices for the calculator) or reserves (v5.891, who holds the gold: the official gold of every country from the IMF International Liquidity file in tonnes, its value at the live price, percent of reserves, last month and twelve month change, the month it is for and the day first seen, with the header totals, net central bank buying over 1, 3 and 12 months, top buyer and seller and the dip buyers; give country as a three letter ISO code, for example POL, for one country with its full history and a plain read; reserves are reported monthly and late, not live). Moving together is not proof that money moved from one market to another. Page: owlchart.com/gold.html. Data, not advice.

country.description: reserves: a three letter ISO country code for one country, or leave empty for the summary and the top 25

days.description: rotation: the window in days, default 90

what.description: which gold data set, default brief
